importDir.description: Folder scanned recursively for manually created DiscordChatExporter JSON imports (`-f Json`). Manual imports remain supported.

syncEnabled.description: Enable hourly bounded account sync. No data is fetched until an account is connected or tokenEnv is configured.

syncScope.description: all considers every visible server and DM; selected collects only configured channels, guilds, and optionally DMs. Both modes use bounded reads rather than full-history exports.

dceCommand.description: Legacy DiscordChatExporter command override. The bounded account sync does not invoke this exporter.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable providing a Discord token when no account is connected. Stored account credentials take precedence.

channels.description: Channel or thread IDs to collect. With selected scope, these and the configured guilds determine eligibility; child threads follow their parent channel.

guilds.description: Server IDs to consider for bounded collection. With selected scope, only these servers and configured channels are eligible.

includeDMs.description: Include direct messages and group DMs with selected scope. User-token all scope always includes them; bot accounts cannot read personal DMs.

includeThreads.description: none omits threads; active discovers active threads; all also rotates through archived thread metadata. Messages are fetched under the shared run budget.

initialSyncDays.description: Legacy exporter initial-history setting retained for existing configurations.

downloadMedia.description: Legacy exporter media-download setting retained for existing configurations.

exportDir.description: Legacy exporter working folder retained for existing configurations.

keepExports.description: Legacy exporter file-retention setting retained for existing configurations.

syncTimeoutMinutes.description: Legacy exporter per-channel timeout retained for existing configurations.

exportParallel.description: Legacy exporter parallelism setting retained for existing configurations.

gapMinutes.description: A silence longer than this starts a new conversation window.

maxWindowMessages.description: Maximum messages per indexed conversation window.

maxWindowChars.description: Maximum transcript characters per indexed window.

idleMinutes.description: A settled conversation window waits this long without new messages before relevance evaluation.

maxWindowsPerRun.description: Legacy summarization batch limit retained for existing configurations.

summarize.description: Summarise each window with the chat LLM; otherwise a heuristic summary is used.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for window summaries. Empty uses the default.

excludeBots.description: Leave bot messages out of transcripts.

namespace.description: Namespace for Discord sources and graph entities.

relevanceEnabled.description: Evaluate settled conversation windows against your configured interests and explicit include/exclude rules.

selfUserIds.description: Your Discord user IDs. The connected user token identifies you automatically; set IDs explicitly for bot-token syncs and manual imports.

interests.description: Topics and themes relevant to you. These are combined with activity from Shale and the configured interestProfile.

excludedTopics.description: Topics that should always exclude a window. Explicit exclusions take precedence over inclusions.

includedPeople.description: People whose conversations should be included; entries may be Discord user IDs or names.

excludedPeople.description: People whose conversations should always be excluded; entries may be Discord user IDs or names. Exclusions take precedence.

includedConversations.description: Conversation/channel IDs or names to include explicitly.

excludedConversations.description: Conversation/channel IDs or names to exclude explicitly. Exclusions take precedence.

interestProfile.description: Access profile used to read Shale activity when deriving interests. Keep this scoped to data you permit Discord relevance evaluation to use.

relevanceThreshold.description: Minimum relevance score required to index a settled window.

relevanceModel.description: Optional model override for relevance evaluation. Empty uses the configured default.

rawRetentionDays.description: Maximum age in days for retained raw connector records.

rawMaxMiB.description: Maximum total size in MiB for retained raw connector records.

rawMaxConversationMessages.description: Maximum raw messages retained for one conversation.

syncBudgetMinutes.description: Maximum time spent in one hourly sync run. Bounded polling samples recent activity and does not guarantee complete historical intervals.

syncMaxRequests.description: Maximum Discord API requests in one sync run.

syncMaxMessages.description: Maximum messages fetched in one sync run.

relevanceMaxWindows.description: Maximum settled windows evaluated in one run.

relevanceMaxLLMCalls.description: Maximum relevance model calls in one run; zero disables model calls.

backfillMaxMessages.description: Maximum older messages fetched per conversation during bounded backfill.
